entries.claim: The reception of Your Body, Lord Jesus Christ, which I, though unworthy, dare to receive,

The conclusion on this page supplies the historical wording basis for this revised English rendering; the current English reads “who, being God, live and reign with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit forever and ever. Amen.” The current rendering is revised, not a verbatim quotation.
